title: Evening class booking
story: A training centre takes bookings for evening classes and shows the booking back to the student.

durability.basis: transcribed from the pilot archetype and hand-reviewed; test/spec.test.mjs keeps the two in step

state.lifetime: per process, in a file named on the command line - not a durable store

tables.name: records
tables.purpose: the value a write stores, read back by the reference the server issued

persistence.reference: server-issued reference, returned in the Location header of a 303
persistence.reload_assertion: reloading /booking/<ref> still shows the stored notes value; the value is read from SQLite, not from the form

routes.effect: refuse the submission if a required field is missing; otherwise store the booking and redirect
read the booking by reference and show the notes back to the student

validation.on_missing: the server refuses the submission and re-renders the form; nothing is stored
validation.on_success: insert one row into records and answer 303 with Location: /booking/<ref>

acceptance: after a successful submit the browser lands on /booking/<ref> and the echoed notes text is present
reloading that URL still shows it, which is only possible if the server stored it
an empty submit is observed to be refused by the server rather than silently accepted
the reference in the URL was issued by this submission, not read from a row that already existed
